title: Pure Malefic
summary: Malefic cards with the two originals their summons banish from the Extra Deck, plus generic staples. The page's end board adds Bystial and Number 38 cards, so it uses cards this list leaves out. Each Malefic summons itself by banishing its original, but Malefic Paradox Gear can be banished in its place, so the Blue-Eyes, Red-Eyes and Rainbow originals stay out. The 2026 Traps lead: Paradigm Shift finds Malefic World and summons any Malefic straight from the Deck or Extra Deck, from the hand if needed, and Malefic Force searches and wipes the field. Every Malefic dies without a Field Spell, so World and Territory are run at full count.

allow.Stardust Dragon: Malefic Stardust Dragon banishes it from the Extra Deck to summon itself, and Paradigm Dragon revives it.
allow.Cyber End Dragon: Malefic Cyber End Dragon banishes it from the Extra Deck to summon itself.
allow.Cosmic Blazar Dragon: Ultimate Synchro boss providing an all-encompassing Quick Effect negation.

main: Malefic Paradox Gear
Tributes itself to summon Parallel Gear and search a Malefic; stands in for any original a Malefic would banish.
Malefic Parallel Gear
Tuner that makes Malefic Paradox Dragon with a Malefic from the hand.
Malefic Stardust Dragon
Banishes Stardust Dragon to summon itself; protects your Field Spell.
Malefic Cyber End Dragon
Banishes Cyber End Dragon to summon itself: 4000 ATK.
Malefic Blue-Eyes White Dragon
Summons itself through Paradox Gear: 3000 ATK.
Malefic Red-Eyes Black Dragon
Summons itself through Paradox Gear: a Level 7 body.
Malefic Rainbow Dragon
Summons itself through Paradox Gear: 4000 ATK.
Malefic Paradigm Dragon
Banishes a Malefic from the Extra Deck; mills a Malefic to revive a banished Level 8 Synchro.
Malefic Truth Dragon
Pays half your LP to replace a fallen Malefic; wipes their monsters in battle.
Malefic World
The Field Spell everything needs; trades your draw for a Malefic card.
Malefic Territory
Places Malefic World from the Deck and lets you control several differently named Malefics.
Malefic Selector
Banishes two Malefic cards to search two more.
Malefic Divide
Quick-Play: revives a Malefic, ignoring its conditions.
Malefic Paradigm Shift
Newest support. Adds or places Malefic World, then summons a Malefic from the Deck or Extra Deck; can be activated from the hand.
Malefic Force
Newest support. Equip that searches a Malefic card; from the GY, wipes every monster with a Field Spell out.
Malefic Tune
Draws two when a Malefic falls; from the GY, searches one.
extra: Parallel Gear + a Malefic: revives a Synchro from either GY.
Level 10 Synchro: Special Summons a banished LIGHT/DARK monster, and shuffles a banished card to destroy or negate.
Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy
Rank 8: negates and attaches an opponent's Spell card once per turn and redirects attacks.
Level 12 Synchro: targets a Level 7+ Synchro to return itself and cheat out another Dragon Synchro of equal Level.
Level 12 Synchro: banishes itself until End Phase to negate a summon, card effect activation, or attack.
